run: pt-soak-02.json (fourth run of 2026-09-25, harness verdict PASS)
why: The harness judges the first quarter of the samples against the last. In this run the first quarter (19:35-20:35 local) overlapped heavy load from other sessions on the same machine, while the last quarter (22:35-23:35) was quiet. Four comparisons use the first quarter as their baseline and become easier to pass under that load: callback backlog, window-close lag, deadline slack and core round duration. This file repeats the sample-based comparisons against the only quiet window before the load began, with the harness's own thresholds.

provenance.method: The run used a git archive of d989c31, built in Release, outside any git repository. That is why the harness wrote commit "", and why its tracked_tree_clean: true means nothing here: git status could not run. After the run, the directory was compared file by file with a fresh git archive of the same commit. It was identical apart from bin/, obj/, ci-artifacts/ (the harness's logs), a .soak-commit marker, and the two files the harness wrote into docs/evidence/W-0037.

launch: Started 19:35:11 local through WMI (Win32_Process.Create) with its window hidden, so neither a restart of the Claude Code process nor a closed window could end it.

sources: From 19:43 to about 22:00: three ops-core integration test hosts (Ginsengfood.Operational.*.Tests) and the IVR lot L6 session's integration test run in the main working tree, seen with a per-process CPU sample at 19:44 and again at 20:36.
From 20:36 to 20:45 this session built and ran unit and integration tests for the RuntimeGateApprovals.cs part of K-31, inside the middle half.

criteria.name: expired windows are closed promptly
criteria.limit: last-quarter median lag <= quiet-window median + 30 s

criteria.name: deadline slack does not erode
criteria.limit: last-quarter median slack >= quiet-window median - 30 s

observed.note: per-round durations are not in the samples; the harness compared 983 core rounds itself. Its first-quarter median was 12684 ms under load and its last-quarter median 8595 ms; the only core round timed before the load, round 1 at 19:35, took 12126 ms. The last quarter is faster than that too.
